parsed.post: New personal best (0.8365)! Increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.10 with MATRIX_LR=0.04 seems to be providing better stability and convergence than 0.05. For the final round, I'll push the LR even lower to 0.03 to see if the descent continues to pay off.
parsed.description: Decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to see if further lower learning rates continue to improve convergence, following the successful trend of LR reduction.
